title: Kelvin Sheppard: "Disrespectful" to call loss of Terrion Arnold a "setback"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kelvin Sheppard: "Disrespectful" to call loss of Terrion Arnold a "setback"
sources.description: The Lions moved on from cornerback Terrion Arnold after his arrest on multiple felony charges arising from an alleged armed robbery and kidnapping.
